classification: REVIEW-ONLY PROPOSAL; no extraction probe, no production application

ownership_and_loans.drop_order: Owned View drops in tx1_finish before outer sem, whereas original View drops after sem. View contains only Variant, WideExact, shared slices and Option<&[u8;32]>; it has no Drop implementation, so this drop-point change has no destructor/allocation/logging effect. Geometry Vec then accumulator Vec then Prepared Box still drop before sem Box in their original relative order; copy fields/arrays/hash/Observer have no custom destructor.
ownership_and_loans.evaluation_order: Only caller argument evaluation of existing locals/references is added (no computation or fallible argument). Prepare mark remains before helper. Entire geometry/while/checkpoint/CheckpointWrite/Ok body remains byte-identical.
ownership_and_loans.external_borrows: View stores references into unchanged proof bytes. Helper receives the same proof/public borrowed arguments separately; shared aliases remain shared. No mutable external borrow or returned borrow is introduced.
ownership_and_loans.hash_copy: Digest32: Copy in crates/aspis-core/src/digest.rs:6. H cannot implement Drop. Moving H into helper preserves the same by-value Copy uses in unchanged query loop/checkpoint. No Clone implementation is called.
ownership_and_loans.limitation: Source inspection establishes intended ownership shape; no rewritten source has been compiled/extracted. Actual borrowcheck/native gate still required after user approval.
ownership_and_loans.retained_outer_local: sem:Verified<H> stays in tx1, is not borrowed by tx1_finish. Verified and Prepared have no lifetime parameters; Prepared carries no references into sem or View. The preceding shared borrows passed to verify_observed/Prepared::new do not escape those calls.

scope: Allows visible actual tx1 prefix to be interpreted with a universal query/checkpoint continuation at a real source boundary; does not refine the opaque tail or current verify_observed source.
tail_correspondence: Exact bytes: geometry setup, unchanged while, checkpoint, observer mark, Ok(bytes). All original owned locals transfer once to helper; helper is Result-returning and no operation, allocation, arithmetic or first-error order is added/reordered.
